Task Name: Define scope, goals and success measures
Description: Write the one-page scope for the post-programme placement and retention tracer: who is verified, what 'verified' means, target volumes (25-case pilot, then thousands), and the measures of success (response rate, verification rate, cost per verified case, review load). Done when the product lead has signed the page.

Tech lead architects and guides; Developer A owns web app, authentication and Zoho-side items; Developer B owns the agent, channels and tools; product lead owns scope and policy decisions. Record in a RACI table. Done when everyone has confirmed their area.

Task Name: Set up the Zoho Projects or Sprints project
Description: Create the project, import milestones and tasks from this plan, define statuses (Open, In Progress, In Review, Closed), priorities, sprint cadence (two weeks) and the board. Add owners. Done when the plan is imported, dates are checked and the first sprint is started.

Create the git repository (first commit and remote), a main branch protected from direct pushes, feature branches, and a PR template. Rules from the EdZola AI policy: every AI-assisted PR is reviewed by a human before merge and is tagged as AI-assisted. Done when a test PR has gone through review and merge.

Run type checks, the full test suite and the build on every pull request (workflow file exists, not yet run). Block merges when it fails. Add a cost cap on any test that calls a model. Done when a failing test blocks a PR.

Task Name: Plan and create Development, UAT and Production environments
Description: Three Catalyst projects (the current one is Development) with a configuration table: keys, WhatsApp numbers, allowlists, flags, domains. Rule: nothing in UAT or Production uses testing overrides. Done when UAT exists and a config matrix is documented.

List every key (PII encryption key, Interakt API key and webhook secret, Anthropic key, job token, gateway secret, ZoLabs key) with owner, location, backup and rotation interval. The PII key cannot be recovered if lost, so keep a copy in the team password manager. Done when the inventory is reviewed and each key has a backup.

Record the top risks with owner and mitigation: WhatsApp tier limits, provider outages, agent cost, data residency, ZoLabs API maturity, instrument sign-off delay, Catalyst cost spikes. Review weekly. Done when the first version is agreed.
Weekly demo, sprint review and retrospective, a status note to stakeholders, and the Wednesday demo. Decide channels (Cliq group, Zoho Projects). Done when the calendar invites are sent.

Task Name: AI usage policy checklist for this project
Description: Turn the EdZola AI policy into a checklist for the team: synthetic data only in development, no PII or keys in prompts, human review of AI code, client consent before any browser or MCP session on a client's system, Claude drafts and humans send. Add it to the PR template. Done when the checklist is in the repository and used in reviews.

Task Name: Review the Core Team Walkthrough and the prototype
Description: Read the walkthrough PDF and explore the full prototype to capture the locked model: status and outcome are separate, eight tools, ZoLabs voice, Sprint 1A walking skeleton before the 25-case pilot. Done when the locked decisions are listed in the architecture document.
Document the life of a case from mission creation to closure for the placement and retention tracer, with actors and data at each step. Done when the flow diagram was reviewed with the team.

Choose Zoho Catalyst (Advanced I/O, AppSail, Data Store, Cron, hosting, authentication), TypeScript monorepo, Interakt now and Meta Cloud API later, Claude for the agent, ZoLabs for voice. Record each decision with the reason. Done when the architecture document lists them.

Estimate monthly and per-case cost for Catalyst (functions, Data Store, Cron), WhatsApp (marketing, utility and service conversations), Claude (agent runs and prompt caching), ZoLabs (call minutes) and Interakt plan. Show best and worst cases. Done when the product lead has reviewed it and it is stored with the plan.

Task Name: System architecture document and team diagram
Description: Maintain ARCHITECTURE.md and the published application flow diagram used to onboard the team. Done when a new developer can explain the flow after reading it. Must be updated again after the agentic redesign.

Task Name: Data model and Data Store design
Description: One append-only document table with a unique key for atomic compare-and-set, a hash-chained ledger, tombstone erasure, keyed phone hash with AES-256-GCM. Done when the store contract tests pass for both the in-memory and Catalyst stores.

Define who can see what: the agent never sees names or phone numbers, personal data is erasable while the audit trail stays anonymous, staff roles, consent recording. Done when reviewed against the AI policy and data-handling table.

Task Name: Product team architecture review (12 Oct): capture feedback
Description: Record the product leads' feedback: Verification Employee as a reusable AI employee above missions, agent decides channel and next action, tools master, mission templates with program context, UI for missions, per-client authentication, ZoLabs to be tested. Done when the feedback is written up and shared.

Write the decision record: DozAI Core, then Verification Employee, then Mission, then Case or session; the agent chooses tools instead of a fixed WhatsApp-then-call workflow; what stays as hard guardrails. Include options considered and the cost and testing trade-offs. Done when the product lead signs the record.

Get answers to the blocking questions: one employee for all missions or one per mission; may the agent write its own message text or only approved wording at first; may participant replies reach the model; Managed Agents or our own tool loop; who owns escalations; reminder policy. Done when each is recorded with an owner and date.

Define the employee: name, purpose, persona and tone, core instructions, knowledge, guardrails, allowed tools, data access rules, human escalation rules, memory and context policy, logging and audit settings, model and runtime settings. Only EdZola staff may create or change it. Done when the spec is reviewed by the product lead.

Define a mission: objective, questions, contact window, retry policy, consent requirements, outcome criteria, program context variables (name, description, organisation), mission knowledge, template mapping and assigned employee. Done when the spec covers the placement and retention mission end to end.

Four layers: base DozAI knowledge, employee definition, mission context, case or session context. Decide what each contains, which part is cached, what the case digest holds, and what is remembered between wakes. Done when a sample assembled context is reviewed.

Task Name: Tools master and guardrail contract design
Description: Define the tool registry (WhatsApp, ZoLabs, later email, SMS, connectors), the per-employee allow-list, the contract of each channel-neutral action, the reason each action must carry, and which checks are guardrails (consent, hours, attempts, caps, opt-out, approved wording) rather than workflow steps. Done when the tool specs are reviewed.

Decide how consent is captured and proved: attestation at import, consent in the first WhatsApp message, consent at the start of a ZoLabs call, how it is recorded and when it expires. Done when the model is reviewed against the privacy law and the client agreement template.

Design the screens: employee configuration (internal), mission builder with simulator, campaigns, case timeline with agent reasons, review queue, reports. Include empty, loading and error states and mobile. Done when the designs are reviewed.

Task Name: Interview instrument: 34 questions in English and Hindi
Description: The programme team writes and approves the questionnaire wording with branching, follow-up probes and the confirmation questions the agent may ask. Everything currently in the system is draft wording. Blocks the pilot. Done when signed off in writing.

Task Name: Data policy: participant replies and transcripts and the model
Description: Decide whether participant free-text replies and call transcripts may be sent to the model, with what redaction, and for which clients. Record retention. Blocks the agent-driven interview. Done when the decision is signed by the product lead.

Define the test levels (unit, integration, end to end, agent evaluations, voice, load, security, UAT), tools, environments, data rules and exit criteria for each milestone. Done when approved by the tech lead and product lead.

Task Name: Wednesday demo plan and dry run
Description: Prepare the dry configuration for the Wednesday demo: Catalyst, cloud agent, tools, ZoLabs and WhatsApp configured, a scripted walkthrough, and a fallback if a service fails. Done when the dry run has been completed once.
TypeScript workspace with packages for contracts, domain, core, adapters and Catalyst, plus the API function, the gateway and the web app. Done when everything builds from one command.

One source of truth for every shape that crosses a boundary: cases, participants, evidence, ledger events, tool inputs, missions and campaigns, validated with zod. Done when API, tools and tests all use them.

Task Name: Case state machine and contact policy
Description: Pure functions for legal status moves, outcome rules and the contact gate (window, attempts, consent). Done when all transitions are tested including opt-out from any status.
Every change is an event with an actor and a reason, chained by hash so tampering is detectable, with no personal data in it. Done when the verification endpoint reports a valid chain.

Task Name: Store port and Catalyst Data Store adapter
Description: Storage interface with an in-memory version and a Catalyst version on one append-only table with atomic compare-and-set through a unique key. The table was created through infrastructure import. Done when the same contract tests pass on both.
Express API on Catalyst Advanced I/O: cases, review decisions, audit, sessions, summary, conversation view, import, delete. Done when API tests cover roles and errors.
Catalyst hosted sign-in with roles taken from a configuration setting (admin, agent operations, operator, reviewer); anyone not listed is refused. Replaced later by M7.
Eight approved tools with state checks, idempotency, version checks and case binding; signed session tokens; the gateway deployed on AppSail. Done when a refused call returns a clear error code.
Command centre, cases, review queue, agent engine and sessions, audit trail and mission page, reading everything from the API with no sample data. Done when the UI test passes against the real API.
One command builds and deploys the function, scheduler, gateway and web app; secrets are injected only during deploy and then removed. Done when a clean deploy works from the repository.
Unit tests, store contract tests, API tests and a browser-level UI test, run with one command (210 tests today). Done when the suite runs in under a minute.

Remove all synthetic data, add import of real participants with a consent attestation, delete a case with erasure, remove demo flags from defaults, and audit every module. Done when the app starts empty and an erase test shows no personal data remains.

Task Name: Interakt account, API key and send allowlist
Description: Configure the Interakt account, store the key safely, set the allowlist so only approved numbers receive test messages. Done when a template reaches an allowlisted phone.

Task Name: Create and approve the intro template
Description: Create the intro template (purpose, caller, consent buttons) and get Meta approval. Done when 'placement_intro_v1' is approved and sends.

Task Name: Outbound template send and delivery receipts
Description: Send the template through the Interakt API and record sent, delivered and read statuses against the case. Done when receipts appear in the case history.

Task Name: Webhook with signature checks, inbox and de-duplication
Description: Verify the signature, store each event once (phone replaced by a keyed hash), acknowledge quickly, and process from an inbox so events are never lost. Done when bad signatures are rejected and duplicates ignored.

Task Name: Inbound customer replies (plan upgrade and webhook setting)
Description: Upgrade Interakt to the Advanced plan and enable 'Message received from customers'. Done when a real reply produced a case event.
Send questions and replies as ordinary messages inside the 24-hour window. Verified live on 12 Oct with a full interview. Done when a full interview completes on real WhatsApp.

Task Name: Interview runner version 1 (rules) with gold-set tests
Description: Fixed approved questions, answer capture, FAQ, re-ask, stop, wrong person, distress and deletion handling, 30 scripted conversations. Under the agentic design it becomes a capability the agent can use. Done when the gold set passes.
A small model that only picks one meaning from a fixed list for replies the rules cannot place; off by default. Done when injection tests show it cannot invent an option.

Task Name: Decision: Meta Cloud API versus Interakt long term
Description: Decide using cost, control, number ownership and access to the Meta business account. The team's note: a new number can be created directly on Meta later; Interakt stays for now. Done when the decision and the target date are recorded.

Send templates and text, handle the webhook handshake and signature, parse replies and statuses, behind the same channel interface so nothing else changes. Only if the decision says so. Done when a test number completes an interview.
Naming convention, categories, approval process and owner for templates; create and approve the pilot templates in English and Hindi. Done when every template a mission needs is approved.
Track the number's daily new-conversation limit, quality rating, block and report signals, and failed sends; alert before limits are reached. Done when a dashboard shows them.

Task Name: Interakt plan payment and cancel reminder
Description: Get the Advanced plan approved and paid through the finance group, set a reminder to review or cancel it, and confirm there are no extra add-on charges. Done when finance confirms and the reminder exists.
People whose first message failed stay in 'waiting' today. Add a retry or reset action (single and bulk) with a clear reason shown on the case. Done when a failed send can be retried from the app.

Task Name: Voice notes, images and unsupported replies
Description: Decide and implement what happens with media: ask for text, hand to a person, or route to voice. Done when each type has an approved response and a test.
Missions hold the first message, questions, rules and agent notes; saved versions never change; checked before saving; stored in pieces. Done when two missions run side by side in tests.

Task Name: Cases pinned to a mission version
Description: A case keeps the mission it started under, so edits never change a running conversation. Done when an old case keeps old wording after a new mission is added.

Task Name: Campaigns: pacing, daily cap, contact hours, pause and stop
Description: A campaign sends first messages in small batches, exactly within the daily cap, inside contact hours, with no double messages even if runs overlap. Done when concurrency tests pass.

Task Name: Automatic pause when sends keep failing
Description: Pause a campaign when the latest five first messages all fail and show the reason. Done when tests cover mixed and pending results.

Task Name: Campaigns screen, mission picker and add-a-mission form
Description: Campaigns page with progress and controls, mission chooser at import, and an admin form to add a mission from JSON. Done when the browser test creates and starts a campaign.

Task Name: Create the Catalyst Cron schedule (every minute)
Description: Manual step in the Catalyst console: a Cron job that calls the scheduler function every minute. Until it exists, batches after the first need the manual button. Done when the campaign page shows a recent 'last run' without pressing anything.

Task Name: Schedule a campaign to start later
Description: The meeting asked for 'scheduled or instant'. Add a start date and time, shown in India time, with the scheduler honouring it. Done when a scheduled campaign starts by itself.

Decide and implement reminders after silence: how many, how long to wait, which channel, and when to give up. Under the agentic design the mission states the rule and the employee follows it. Done when a silent participant gets exactly the allowed follow-ups.

Task Name: Spike: own tool loop versus Managed Agents
Description: Compare keeping our tool loop with Anthropic Managed Agents sessions (hosted agent calling our gateway over MCP): control, cost, visibility in the console, session limits and how an employee definition maps to each. A colleague already runs a cloud agent from Python. Done when a recommendation is written and agreed.

Store each employee version (identity, persona, instructions, knowledge references, guardrails, allowed tools, data rules, escalation rules, memory policy, logging, model). Saved versions never change; only platform staff can write. Done when two versions can be stored and one chosen.

Task Name: Assign an employee to a mission; pin both on each case
Description: A mission names its employee; each case pins employee version and mission version when created; older cases keep working. Done when the agent reads the right pair for every case.

Task Name: Context builder: base, employee, mission and case layers
Description: Assemble the four layers for each run, with the stable parts first so they can be cached, and a size limit. Done when a run shows exactly which layers it received and the token counts.

Task Name: Case digest: what the agent needs to decide
Description: A tool that returns consent, attempts per channel, timers, last messages as references to approved text, evidence and what is still missing, with no names or numbers. Done when the agent can explain from the digest why it chose a channel.
A registry of tools with schema, risk level and owner; the gateway only offers the tools an employee is allowed. Done when removing a tool from the list removes it from the agent immediately.

Task Name: Channel-neutral action tools (each with a reason)
Description: Replace fixed steps with actions the agent chooses: send a message (approved template or mission question), request a call, schedule a follow-up, ask a confirmation, propose a decision, request review. Every action must state why. Done when the old tools are mapped to the new ones and tested.

One place that enforces consent, contact hours, attempts, daily and per-case caps, opt-out, approved wording and budgets. Relax the state-based tool matrix into these policy checks so the agent can decide freely inside them. Done when every refusal returns a clear code and tests prove nothing can bypass it.

The scheduler wakes a case when something happens: first contact due, participant reply, call result, timeout, human follow-up. Each wake runs once (idempotent), with backoff and a per-case limit. Done when overlapping schedulers never double-run a case.

The agent decides the next question, channel or wait for each case. The rules runner becomes a capability (interpret a reply, next question) the agent can use. Done when a full interview completes with the agent choosing every step.

Task Name: Decision log: reason for every action
Description: Store and show the reason with each action in the case history and session viewer, so the team can see why the agent chose WhatsApp, a call or a wait. Done when a reviewer can read the reasoning of any case.

Task Name: Guided and autonomous modes, with a fallback
Description: A mission can run guided (current rules) or autonomous (agent decides). If the model is unavailable the case falls back to guided or waits and alerts. Done when both modes run the same mission and the fallback is tested.
Per-case budget, per-day wake limits, prompt caching of stable layers, a usage view, and a switch that stops one campaign or the whole employee at once. Done when a runaway test stops at the limit.

Task Name: Participant text and the model: redaction and injection resistance
Description: Implement the data decision: what part of a reply the agent sees, redaction of personal details where required, and treating participant words as data, never instructions. Done when the injection test set fails to move the agent.

Task Name: Confidence and outcome rules per mission
Description: Make the auto-close threshold (85 or 90 percent), conflict checks and review reasons configurable per mission and recorded in the decision log. Done when two missions use different thresholds.
Configure who gets which case (distress, wrong person, deletion request, low confidence), response targets and the message the participant receives. Done when each reason routes to a named queue.

Scripted and model-played participants (cooperative, silent, confused, hostile, distressed, wrong number, Hindi) to run thousands of conversations without sending anything. Done when a scenario file runs a full case.

A gold set of conversations scoring tool choice, wording safety, consent handling, escalation and cost, run before every release with a spend cap. Done when a regression is caught by a failing evaluation.

Task Name: Persona and tone tuning with change control
Description: A process to adjust the employee's tone (for example if it sounds rude): where to edit, test against the gold set, review, publish as a new version, roll back. Done when a tone change goes through the process once.

Write when more than one agent is justified (for example a mission-lead agent that watches thousands of cases and reports status). No build now. Done when the note is filed in the architecture document.

Prove the API end to end: place a call, send a questionnaire, get the answers and transcript back, handle no-answer, busy and wrong-number. The meeting warned it may not work as expected, so test early. Done when a written result lists what works and what does not.

Voice channel behind the same interface as WhatsApp: request a call, call status, call result, cancellation; secrets in the settings only. Done when the agent's request-a-call action places a real test call.

Generate the call script from the mission's questions (with the same evidence keys) and review it; monitor what ZoLabs actually asks. Done when answers from a call land as the same evidence as WhatsApp answers.
The call opens by saying who is calling and why, asks consent, and confirms the person before any question; refusal ends the call and records it. Done when a refusal test closes the case correctly.
Calls only in approved hours, a limited number of attempts, and callbacks when asked, using the same guardrails as WhatsApp. Done when attempt and hour limits are tested.

Task Name: Call results into evidence; transcript handling
Description: Save answers as evidence with confidence, store the transcript under the retention rule, and never copy transcripts into AI tools outside the product. Done when a call result appears in the case timeline.

Task Name: Voice-first path when the number is not on WhatsApp
Description: If a participant has no WhatsApp, the agent starts with a call. Done when a non-WhatsApp number goes straight to a call attempt.
Listen to a sample of pilot calls and compare the recorded answers with what was said; fix script or settings. Done when accuracy is within the agreed target.
Track call minutes and cost per case and per campaign next to WhatsApp and model cost. Done when the cost report shows all three.

Task Name: Sign-in with Google or Zoho: OAuth application
Description: Create the OAuth application and store its client ID and secret in Catalyst's authentication settings (a good learning task for a developer). Done when a test user signs in with a work account.
Replace the roles setting with stored users and roles, an invite flow and an admin screen. Done when an admin adds and removes a user without a redeploy.
Add organisations; every mission, case, campaign, user and query is scoped to one. Done when two test clients cannot see each other's data in any screen or API.

EdZola staff manage employees, tools and missions for the first clients; client users see only their organisation; clients can never create or edit an employee. Done when the permission matrix is enforced and tested.

The agent connects with credentials scoped to one tenant and one case at a time, with expiry and rotation; configured when the employee is set up. Done when a stolen token cannot reach another case or tenant.
Automated attempts to read or change another tenant's data through every route, tool and job. Done when every attempt fails and the tests run in CI.
Idle timeout, sign-out everywhere, and a clear message when access is removed. Done when tested in the browser.
Record views of sensitive screens (conversation, evidence) in an audit log visible to admins. Done when a reviewer opening a case leaves a record.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Description: Create and edit employee versions: name, purpose, persona, instructions, knowledge, guardrails, allowed tools, data rules, escalation, memory, logging, model; compare versions, publish, roll back. Done when the employee used in a campaign was created in the screen.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Description: A form-based builder: objective, questions with branching, templates, contact window, retries, consent, outcome rules, program context variables, assigned employee, validation messages, preview. Replaces JSON. Done when a non-technical person builds the pilot mission.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Task Name: Mission lifecycle: clone, version, publish, retire
Description: Clone a mission into a new version, publish, retire, and see which cases use which version. Done when each action is recorded and tested.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Description: Talk to the employee as a participant under a mission without sending anything, and watch its reasoning and tool choices. Done when a mission author can test before publishing.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Description: Schedule start, cohort filters, per-campaign analytics, retry failed sends, and which employee and mission it uses. Done when an operator can run a full campaign without help.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Description: One timeline across WhatsApp and calls showing what the agent chose and why, evidence with its source, and the final reasoning. Done when a reviewer can understand a case without leaving the page.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Description: Filters, assignment to a reviewer, response targets, bulk actions and the reason each case needs a person. Done when reviewers can clear a queue of hundreds efficiently.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Description: Funnel (loaded, contacted, responded, verified), outcomes by cohort, channel effectiveness, review load, and cost per verified case, with CSV export. Done when the programme team confirms the numbers match their records.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Description: Email or Cliq alerts when a case needs review, a campaign pauses or the scheduler stops. Done when each alert reaches the right person once.

Task List: M8 Admin UI: Employees, Missions, Reporting
Task Name: Accessibility, mobile and Hindi interface text
Description: Keyboard use, contrast, screen-reader labels, phone layout, and Hindi labels where staff need them. Done when an accessibility checklist passes.

Task Name: Indexed lookups in the Data Store
Description: The scheduler reads every case each minute. Add columns for status, mission and campaign (plus migration) so it asks directly for 'unsent cases for this mission'. Must be done before a campaign of thousands. Done when a run over 10,000 cases takes seconds.
Lists, audit and evidence load a page at a time; evidence is read per case. Done when screens stay fast with 10,000 cases.
Upload large files in chunks with progress, resume after failure, duplicate and error reports, and consent attestation. Done when 10,000 rows import without timeouts.
Test 10,000 cases through import, a campaign, a webhook burst and many agent wakes, in the UAT project, with a spend cap. Done when results are written and bottlenecks fixed.

Task Name: Catalyst cost analysis and budget alerts
Description: Another project saw a large unexpected Catalyst charge (about a million requests). Check our request counts, the scheduler's per-minute calls and Data Store queries; set budget alerts. Done when a monthly forecast is written and alerts exist.

Task Name: Validate the cost model with real usage
Description: Compare the model from design against measured WhatsApp, Claude, ZoLabs and Catalyst cost during the pilot. Done when differences are explained and the forecast updated.
Verify per case or from checkpoints instead of reading every event. Done when verification of 10,000 cases is quick.
Regular backups of the Data Store, a tested restore, and an export for the client; keys backed up separately. Done when a restore drill succeeds.
Agree how long conversations, evidence and transcripts are kept, and erase on schedule and on request. Done when expiry removes personal data and keeps the anonymous trail.
Respect WhatsApp tier limits, Interakt per-minute limits and ZoLabs concurrency with backoff and queues instead of failures. Done when a limit hit slows the campaign instead of failing it.
List what could go wrong for the agent, the tool gateway, webhooks, imports, login and the data store; rank by impact; assign fixes. Done when each high risk has an owner and a test.

Try to make the agent or reply reader reveal data, ignore rules, message the wrong person or take a forbidden action, using hostile replies. Done when every attack is blocked and kept as a regression test.

Names and employers are stored in plain text; encrypt them or confirm table-level protection and restrict table permissions to the project's functions. Done when a database export shows no readable personal data.
Limits on the API and webhook endpoints, request size limits and alerts on bursts. Done when a flood test is absorbed.

Task Name: Dependency and secret scanning in CI
Description: Fail the build on a known vulnerable package or a committed secret. Done when a planted secret is caught.

Task Name: Penetration test or independent security review
Description: An external or independent review of the live UAT environment; fix findings by severity. Done when no high findings remain open.

Review consent records, purpose limits, deletion, and the fact that the Catalyst data centre is in the US and the model is hosted by Anthropic; decide what clients must be told or what must move. Done when the product lead and a client contact accept the position.

Data processing terms, written client consent before any session on a client's system, the AI usage notice, and scoped access with immediate disconnect afterwards. Done when the pilot client has signed.
Who does what, how clients are told, how to stop the agent and campaigns, and how to preserve evidence. Done when a tabletop exercise has been run once.
One documented way to stop all sending and agent runs within a minute (campaign stop, employee switch, provider key revoke). Done when it has been practised.
Rotate the webhook secret, job token and gateway secret without downtime and prove the PII key backup restores. Done when the drill notes are filed.
Every request, wake, tool call and provider call logs one line with a case reference and no personal data. Done when one case can be traced across all logs.
Alert on failed sends, rejected webhooks, agent errors, paused campaigns, scheduler not running, wake backlog and cost thresholds, to the right channel. Done when each alert has fired in a test.
Health of the function, webhook, gateway and scheduler; queue depth; wake backlog; spend today. Done when on-call can see problems at a glance.
Step-by-step guides for webhook failures, provider outage, stuck cases, a paused campaign, a bad deploy and rollback. Done when someone who did not write them can follow them.
A token-protected read-only case history view exists; add a safe replay and a case health check in the admin screen. Done when support can explain any case without database access.
External checks on the API, webhook endpoint and gateway with alerts. Done when an outage test notifies the team.
Map each requirement to tests and acceptance criteria so nothing ships untested. Done when every requirement has at least one test.

Task Name: Automated tests for the new core
Description: Unit and integration tests for the employee record, context builder, tools, guardrails, wake mechanism and tenancy, alongside the code. Done when coverage targets are met and CI is green.
Full journeys on UAT with simulated WhatsApp and voice: import, campaign, interview, agent decision, review, close, delete. Done when the suite runs in CI against UAT.
Run the evaluation set on every release candidate with a spend cap and a pass mark. Done when a bad prompt change fails the build.
A short checklist run on real phones: first message, receipts, replies, question, stop, unclear reply, delete. Done when it is run and recorded for every release.
Answered, no answer, busy, wrong person, consent refusal, mid-call hang-up, Hindi and English, background noise. Done when every case behaves as designed.
Native speakers review every Hindi message, question, template and call script for meaning and tone. Done when the programme team signs off.
Test screens with a keyboard and a screen reader and check WhatsApp wording for clarity. Done when issues are logged and fixed.
Severity rules, who triages and when, how fixes are verified and added to the regression pack. Done when the process is used in sprint 3.
A separate Catalyst project with synthetic data, the real number or an approved test number, and production-like settings (no testing overrides). Done when a full journey works there.

Task Name: Load the signed-off mission (English and Hindi)
Description: Enter the approved instrument as a mission with its templates, contact rules and employee. Done when a simulator run follows the signed-off wording exactly.
Templates for the pilot are approved and tested on real phones. Done when every pilot message type sends.

Task Name: UAT test cases and acceptance criteria
Description: Write the scenarios with the programme team: happy path, silent, unclear, stop, wrong person, distress, voice fallback, review, deletion. Done when the programme team approves the list.
Short guides and a live session on the review queue, campaigns, missions, deletion requests and what to do when the system pauses. Done when each trainee completes a practice case.

Task Name: Pilot cohort data and consent preparation
Description: Prepare 25 participants with consent confirmed by the programme team, a clean CSV and the attestation. No real data in development. Done when the cohort is ready in UAT.
Run the pilot campaign on real WhatsApp (and voice where needed) with the team watching. Done when all 25 cases reach a final state or a recorded reason.
Each day read transcripts, agent reasons, failures and cost; list what to fix. Done when each day's findings are logged with owner and severity.
Fix pilot and UAT defects by severity and retest. Done when no high or medium defects remain.
The programme team and product lead sign the acceptance record. Done when signed.

Task Name: Pilot report and go or no-go review
Description: Report response rate, verification rate, review load, cost per case, issues and recommendation. Done when the decision is recorded.
Create the production project, domain, certificate, roles and access. Done when the sign-in works on the production address.
Generate fresh production keys (never reuse development ones), store and back them up, and record custody. Done when the inventory is updated.

Task Name: Production WhatsApp number, templates and ZoLabs
Description: Production number on Interakt or Meta, approved templates, ZoLabs production settings and allowlists removed. Done when a live test message and a live test call work.

Task Name: Production Data Store, backups and retention
Description: Create the table with its columns and indexes, schedule backups, and set retention. Done when a restore test passes in production.

Production must not carry the 24-hour contact window, the delete-everything switch, the draft-questions switch or the send allowlist. Add a start-up check that refuses to boot with them. Done when a deploy with a testing flag fails.
Checklist covering approvals, backups, alerts, runbooks, on-call, contacts, rollback and comms; freeze changes for 48 hours before go-live. Done when every line is ticked by an owner.
Order of deployment, how to roll back each part, and how to pause campaigns during a problem. Done when a rollback has been rehearsed in UAT.

Task Name: Production smoke test and first live campaign
Description: Deploy, run the smoke checklist, then start a small first campaign with the programme team watching. Done when the first live cohort completes without a high defect.
Tell the client and stakeholders what is live, what to expect, and whom to contact. Done when sent.
Confirm that no development or test personal data moves to production and that development data is wiped. Done when a check confirms it.

Task Name: Hypercare: two weeks of close monitoring
Description: Daily review of campaigns, alerts, cost and cases needing a person; same-day fixes; a short daily note. Done when two weeks pass without a high defect.

Administrator guide, reviewer guide, mission authoring guide, employee management guide, architecture, API and runbooks, all reviewed. Done when a new team member can operate the system from the documents.

Task Name: Knowledge transfer to delivery and support
Description: Sessions for the EdZola delivery and support teams with recordings. Done when support handles a mock incident alone.
What worked, what did not, estimates versus actuals, and changes for the next project. Done when actions are logged.
Compare actual cost with the model and set pricing guidance for new clients. Done when the product lead has the report.
Confirm all milestones, open items moved to the roadmap, and sign-off by the product lead. Done when signed.

Task Name: Email tool (Zeptomail and our sending address)
Description: Add email as a tool: Zeptomail or SMTP, from-address authentication, templates and consent. Not in the first release.
Add SMS as a tool, with provider, consent and opt-out. Not in the first release.
Let the employee read and write approved files and records through connectors with scoped access. Not in the first release.

Task Name: Multi-agent: mission lead and reviewer agents
Description: A mission-lead agent that reviews thousands of cases and reports status; a reviewer agent for approvals. Build only when volume needs it.
Mature clients create and deploy their own missions (never employees) from the builder, with review. Not in the first release.

Task Name: Client portal with their own data
Description: A read-only portal for client staff with reports and exports, isolated per organisation. Not in the first release.
Design new use cases (for example attendance follow-up, scholarship verification) as missions, adding tools as needed. Not in the first release.
Add further languages for messages, calls and the interface. Not in the first release.
